items.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I mentioned Beyoncé and her particular version of a song called Listen, because it reached my heart. It touched me.

ctx.x: But you are a fan of John Legend? No?

I’m not just a fan. I’m – I got a crush on John Legend. I have a crush on Ludacris. Oh yeah. He is fine. I saw him at the – I don’t know what it is – the Oscars or the Grammys, and he came out there in a tuxedo that just blew me away. He looked so good. I like Ludacris. I like – I’m crazy about John Legend. I love his sound, his tonal quality. There’s a resonance in there that just gets to me. I like Seal. I can’t talk about Lady Gaga and people like that, because that’s like – has nothing to do with – who can…
Dreamgirls – I saw her do it in person – she is – she has a magnificent voice, and it doesn’t have to be all of the today’s stuff. She’s got a long life of music ahead of her.
